back: Lower half in a max-heap, upper half in a min-heap. Sizes equal (or low has one more).
Odd count: top of the low heap. Even count: mean of the two tops.
Mark a value as deleted in a counter. Remove it from the heap only when it reaches the top.
Add O(log n), read O(1), memory O(n).
It removes spikes and keeps edges. A mean is dragged by outliers.
